markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second model and all five neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly one class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No reliability flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, Invasive | Both models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; top validated concept association · Validated [F3]
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Score below typical; scarcity associates with invasive · Validated [F4]
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept term, but not given as a reason · Unreliable [F2]
- **Nuclear size** (regions 2, 8, 10) · context · Mean 46 µm², lowest in reference set; against pleomorphism score · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Concept support rests partly on an unreliable mitosis score; smallest-in-reference nuclei argue against pleomorphism.
- Small test set: calibration error 0.05 has CI up to 0.18, so 99% may be overstated.

## Check on the slide
1. **2, 8, 11** · Confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **2, 5, 10** · Look for true mitoses; the score failed spot check.
3. **2, 8, 10** · Nuclei measured small (46 µm²); judge whether pleomorphism is real.
